name: payout-encryption-facts
query: Inspect how doctor payout destination strings are encrypted and decrypted. Return JSON fields algorithm (string), keyBytes (number), ivBytes (number), formatVersion (string). Find the actual implementations and configuration, not just callers.

name: minimum-payout-boundary
query: Inspecione a regra que permite ignorar o minimo do repasse medico por idade do saldo. Retorne JSON com thresholdDays (numero), atExactlyThreshold (boolean: permite ignorar exatamente no limite?), justBelowThreshold (boolean: permite ignorar um milissegundo antes?), defaultMinimumCents (numero).

name: payout-key-validation
query: Inspect validation of the payout destination encryption key. Return JSON with environmentVariable (string), encoding (string), missingKeyThrows (boolean), wrongLengthThrows (boolean).
